description: 4th connection of this batch. 3rd connection retargeted objlib/curlib to the empty &LIB2 library and STILL got `make: Nothing to be done for 'all'. Objects: 0 failed 0 succeed 0 total` (0 rows in both collect queries) - ruling out 'target library already has ZAISRV' as the cause. Per advisor consultation: stop guessing (e.g. whether the project needs qrpglesrc/qsrvsrc directly at the project root instead of nested under src/) and instead read TOBi's own installed files on the host, which are a real primary source even though none of it is mirrored into this repo's work/design/refs/. This connection is READ-ONLY (no build attempted): (1) inspect tobi's own Makefile for how it discovers targets and whether Rules.mk needs to declare them (this batch's Rules.mk is 100% comments - no targets declared - which alone could fully explain all 3 prior 'nothing to be done' results), (2) look for any bundled sample project/README showing the expected directory layout and Rules.mk syntax, (3) run makei/makei build/makei init --help to see if there's a subcommand meant to convert an existing source PF (ZAISRV already lives in QRPGLESRC/QSRVSRC) into an IFS project, which may be the intended learner path rather than hand-writing iproj.json. Every makei invocation is piped `</dev/null` since this harness feeds the whole script to qsh on stdin - if any subcommand prompts, it would otherwise swallow the rest of the script.

steps.label: TOBIREAD
steps.cmd:
export PATH=/QOpenSys/pkgs/bin:$PATH
echo ---MAKEFILE-GREP---
grep -n 'Rules.mk\|SUBDIRS\|include\|wildcard' /QOpenSys/pkgs/lib/tobi/src/mk/Makefile </dev/null 2>&1 | head -80
echo ---MK-DIR---
ls /QOpenSys/pkgs/lib/tobi/src/mk/ </dev/null 2>&1
echo ---SAMPLE-OR-DOCS---
find /QOpenSys/pkgs/lib/tobi \( -iname 'Rules.mk*' -o -iname 'README*' -o -iname '*.md' \) </dev/null 2>&1 | head -40
echo ---RULESMK-REFS-IN-SRC---
grep -rln 'Rules.mk' /QOpenSys/pkgs/lib/tobi/src/makei </dev/null 2>&1 | head
echo ---MAKEI-HELP---
/QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/bash -c 'export PATH=/QOpenSys/pkgs/bin:$PATH; /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/makei --help </dev/null 2>&1'
echo ---MAKEI-BUILD-HELP---
/QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/bash -c 'export PATH=/QOpenSys/pkgs/bin:$PATH; /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/makei build --help </dev/null 2>&1'
echo ---MAKEI-INIT-HELP---
/QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/bash -c 'export PATH=/QOpenSys/pkgs/bin:$PATH; /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/makei init --help </dev/null 2>&1'
echo ---MAKEI-SUBCOMMANDS---
/QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/bash -c 'export PATH=/QOpenSys/pkgs/bin:$PATH; ls /QOpenSys/pkgs/lib/tobi/src/makei/cli/ </dev/null 2>&1'
